# Roadmap: Scrum Master / Agile Coach

## Role overview

Runs Scrum ceremonies and removes blockers for the team.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 3+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Agile & Scrum](../topics/agile.md)

## Also needed

Kanban, Jira, Miro

## Where it leads

Grow: Delivery / Program Manager, Product Owner (PO) · Lead: Delivery / Program Manager · Pivot: Business Analyst (BA), Product Manager (PM)
